note: The SOF0 component sampling byte is read from the JPEG input; the PoC sets Y to 0x31 and Cb/Cr to 0x21.

code: z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err("bad H","Corrupt JPEG");
note: Only range is checked, so horizontal factors 3 and 2 are accepted for different components.
The maximum horizontal sampling factor becomes 3 from the luma component.
The accepted maximum factor is stored in the JPEG state for later resampling.
For the chroma components this computes 3 / 2 with integer division, silently truncating a fractional subsampling ratio to 1 instead of rejecting the JPEG.
The truncated ratio is used to size the number of low-resolution samples passed to the component resampler.

note: The unsupported fractional ratio reaches the row resampler through r->w_lores and r->hs.
